<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_1776078_cyber_0_cyber_incident">suggested_soci_classificationVALCHANGES^EQ<item display_value="-- None --" endquery="false" field="suggested_soci_classification" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Update REG with new SOCI classification</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    //search for related REG in Pending, Open or Work in Progress
    var existingReg = new GlideRecord('x_1776078_cyber_0_regulatory_notification_task');
    existingReg.addQuery('notification_type', 'asd_soci_notification');
    var existingRegOr = existingReg.addQuery('state', '-5');
    existingRegOr.addOrCondition('state', '1');
    existingRegOr.addOrCondition('state', '2');
    existingReg.addQuery('parent_cyber_incident', current.sys_id);
    existingReg.setLimit(1);
    existingReg.query();

    //if task is found update it with the new suggested SOCI classification
    if (existingReg.next()) {
        var newClassification = current.suggested_soci_classification.getDisplayValue() || 'No report';
		existingReg.work_notes = 'The suggested SOCI classification has changed to: ' + newClassification;
        existingReg.update();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-08 03:21:50</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>5a9dd00a8322c71044779cb6feaad36d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Update REG with new SOCI classification</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_5a9dd00a8322c71044779cb6feaad36d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-08 03:33:55</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=5a9dd00a8322c71044779cb6feaad36d"/></record_update>
